COPPER

The COMEX copper price reached a record high in May 2024 and was projected to average $4.20 per pound in full year 2024, an increase of 9% from the annual average price in 2023. Analysts attributed the higher price to multiple factors, such as expectations for reduced global copper supply in the near future, optimistic sentiment regarding world copper demand, strong manufacturing production in China, and decreasing inflation in the United States.
